//: Schematic kinematic model of Robot PU for the 3D view. Boxes only — this is a diagram of where the joints are, not a likeness of the product.
//units: millimetres. Frame is robotics convention: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Origin at the chassis centre.
//provenance: ESTIMATED, pending measurement. Two dimensions in the repo are exact and anchor the rest: the servo body is 22.8 x 12.2 x 28.5 mm (tutorials/specifications.md) and the chassis carries a micro:bit, which is 51.6 x 42.0 mm. Leg segments are one servo plus bracket; overall height lands near 170 mm. Replace these with real numbers — see PLAN-3d-view.md section 1.
//sign: Leg joints use sign -1. The links hang DOWNWARD (-Z) from their joint, so a positive rotation carries the far end backwards/right — the opposite of the 2D panels, where angle>90 means forward. Head pitch keeps +1 because the head grows UPWARD (+Z), which flips the sense back. Verified numerically against the 2D view math; see PLAN-3d-view.md risk 1.
//joints: servo = index into the trace row. axis = rotation axis in the parent frame. origin = joint position in the parent's frame. Rendered rotation is (angle - 90) degrees; 90 is neutral.
//arms: Servos 6-9 are deliberately absent. The ServoJoint enum disagrees with the hardware at indices 7-8 (see PLAN.md section 8), so rendering them would show the wrong limb moving — worse than showing none. Add once the mapping is confirmed on hardware.
//feet: Foot links whose lowest corner defines ground contact, used to settle the figure onto the floor.
